description: accounts' answer: the accounts and defaults as they are after it, and whether the host has claude and what it lacks of each provider's program and each subscription's last read usage (with error, if it couldn't be done); usage's, the limits; sign_in's, each line Claude's sign-in writes (line alone), or Codex's state as it goes (login alone), then its end; callback's, the page codex's server answered (page alone), or error.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

error.description: Why it couldn't be done, for the user as it is.

accounts.description: The host's accounts, by provider then name.

claude.description: Claude's default account's id, "" for the CLI's own sign-in.

defaults.description: Each provider's default for new chats.

usage.description: usage: the subscription's limits; null where they can't be read for its sign-in (a setup token's, an API key's).

line.description: sign_in (Claude's): a line the sign-in wrote (the page to open among them).

login.description: sign_in (Codex's): its state as it goes (login alone: signing_in, then with the page, and the device code's code), then on its end, signed_in or failed.

page.description: callback: what the Codex sign-in's server answered the address.

claude_cli.description: Whether the host has claude: a Claude account there is a folder signed in to with claude auth login; without it, a token from claude setup-token.

missing.description: What the host lacks of a provider's program, by provider (codex: its Codex CLI, as deps says it); a provider that's there isn't in it. Shown in place of Add account.

last_usage.description: Each Claude subscription's usage as the host last read it, by id ("" for the CLI's own sign-in), where that read said its limits: a client shows it greyed till its own usage read answers.

who.description: sign_in, signed in: who as, as claude auth status says (Codex's: the email its sign-in names).
